# mongodb-collation — digest

> Two-thousand-token digest of MongoDB collation: defaults, the three levels and their inheritance, case-insensitive indexes, views, and the gotchas that silently skip an index.

## Digest

- [Definition](../SKILL.md#overview): Collation: locale-aware string comparison/ordering.
- [Default collation](../SKILL.md#overview): Default is locale:"simple" (binary; case-sensitive).
- [Case-insensitive settings](../SKILL.md#the-collation-document): Set strength:1 or 2 for case-insensitive comparison (2 keeps diacritic sensitivity off too); numericOrdering:true for "10">"2".
- [Three levels and inheritance](../SKILL.md#where-collation-is-set-and-inheritance): Collation applies at three levels — collection default, index, query — and inherits down: a query with no explicit collation uses the collection default, falling back to "simple" if none is set.
- [Index-collation match rule](../SKILL.md#case-insensitive-indexes): To use a collated index, the query's effective collation must match the index's exactly, or the index is silently skipped (slow scan or wrong case-sensitivity).
- [Views](../SKILL.md#collation-on-views): Views do NOT inherit the source collection's default collation (they default to "simple"); set it explicitly at view creation, and $lookup across views requires matching collations.
- [Full detail](../SKILL.md#references): Full schema, every citation URL, and the anti-pattern/troubleshooting detail: mongodb-collation SKILL.md and llms-facts.txt in this directory.
